Gerrit change 1763 patch set 2 pushed. Addressed LLM-Review PS1 findings:
- BLOCKING bugfix-size-attestation: ran rebar review-plan on this bug -> PASS, signed at origin/main 27b868b; commit rebased onto that base (PS2 parent = 27b868b).
- Advisory correctness: _snapshot_in_head is now tri-state (True/False/None); an unresolvable HEAD or rc-124 timeout reads INDETERMINATE and recovery KEEPS the journal (defers) instead of misreading a transient git fault as absent-from-HEAD and reverting a landed fold.
- Advisory test gaps: 4 new oracle tests (13 total, all green) — snapshot-gone-from-disk discard branch, indeterminate-probe deferral (rc-124), write_intent-fails refusal (fold returns 1 with zero mutation), and the incomplete-rollback data-loss guard (snapshot RETAINED when a reverse-rename fails, removed when rollback is clean).
- Mutation M7 (rc-124 treated as absent) confirmed KILLED. lint/typecheck/compact suite re-run green (97 passed, 4 skipped).
